
## Trimmed IBTRacs Full Analysis

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ibtracs_trimmed_si_results <- get_report_basin(basin="Southern Indian", all_basins=ibtracs_trimmed_all_basins)
```

```

ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$plot_data
```


### Regression Methods

#### Poisson Regression on non-Shorties

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)
```



Note, this says a decrease of `r abs(coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)[2])` log-storms per year. This corresponds to a `r (1-exp(coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)[2]))*100` percent decrease per season. So over `r num_years_hursat` years, that is a decrease of `r (1-exp(coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)[2])^num_years_hursat)*100` percent.

Using this model, we would predict `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[1]` storms in `r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)` and `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]` storms in `r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`.

That is a change of `r (predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]-predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[1])/num_years_hursat*10` storms per decade.

#### Poisson Regression on Major Storms

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit)
```

Using this model the number of a major storm in `r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)` was `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[1]` and `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]` in `r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`.

That is a change of `r (predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]-predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[1])/num_years_hursat*10` storms per decade.

#### Poisson Regression on Intense Storms

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit)
```


Using this model the number of a major storm in `r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)` was `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[1]` and `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]` in `r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`.

That is a change of `r (predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]-predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[1])/num_years_hursat*10` storms per decade.

#### Logistic Regression on Proportions of Major

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit)
```

We see a significant result with a positive coefficient, so the log-odds of major storms has increased. This tells us the proportion of major storms has increased.

Specifically, using this model the probability of a major storm in `r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)` was `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[1]` and `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]` in `r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`.

That is a change of `r (predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]-predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[1])/num_years_hursat*10*100` percent per decade.

#### Logistic Regression on Proportions of Intense

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit)
```


Specifically, using this model the probability of a major storm in `r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)` was `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[1]` and `r predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]` in `r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`.

That is a change of `r (predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]-predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[1])/num_years_hursat*10*100` percent per decade.

### Change Point Methods

#### Change in Non-Shorty Counts

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test
```

The dates suggest the changepoint would occur from `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]` to `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]+1` with $p$-value `r ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[3]`.

In regime one, the mean number of total storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]])` and in regime two, the mean number of storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])`; a change of `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]) - mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]])`.

#### Change in counts of major storms

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test
```

The dates suggest the changepoint would occur from `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]` to `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]+1` with $p$-value `r ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[3]`.

In regime one, the mean number of major storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]])` and in regime two, the mean number of storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])`; a change of `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]) - mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]])`.

#### Change in counts of intense storms

The dates suggest the changepoint would occur from `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]` to `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]+1` with $p$-value `r ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[3]`.

In regime one, the mean number of intense storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]])` and in regime two, the mean number of storms is `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])`; a change of `r mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]) - mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]])`.

#### Proportion of major storms

A change in the proportion of major storms?
  
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test
```

The change in proportions occurs `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]` to `r 1980+ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1` with $p$-value `r ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[3]`. 

In regime one, the proportion of major storms is `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])` and in regime two, the proportion of major storms is `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])`; a change of `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]) - sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])`.

In regime one, the proportion of major storms is `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])` and in regime two, the proportion of major storms is `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])`; a change of `r sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]) - sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])`.



## Trimmed IBTRacs Test Results

Regression Results (reported in paper)


**Generalized Linear Model Approaches**

Note:

* we report the Likelihood Ratio Test for the generalized linear models, this is better to use than the default $Z$-test provided in the `summary()` output.
* the Change per decade is found by comparing the predicted value at the start time (`r min(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`) and end time (`r max(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$SEASON)`) and scaling by the number of years $\times 10$.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
df <- data.frame(
  Response = c("Cyclone Freq", "Major Freq", "Prop Major", "Intense Freq", "Prop Freq"),
  Coefficent = c(coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)[2], 
                 coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit)[2], 
                 coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit)[2], 
                 coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit)[2], 
                 coef(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit)[2] ),
  `p-value` = c(anova(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], 
                anova(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], 
                anova(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], 
                anova(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], 
                anova(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit)$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]),
  `Start` = c(predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[1], 
              predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[1], 
              predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[1]*100, 
              predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[1],
              predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[1]*100 ),
  `End` = c(predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat],
            predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat],
            predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]*100,
            predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat],
            predict(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_logit_fit, type="response")[num_years_hursat]*100)
)

df |>
  mutate(`Change per Decade` = (End- Start)/num_years_hursat*10) |>
  knitr::kable(digits=5)
```

**Changepoint Methods**

```{r, echo=FALSE}
df <- data.frame(
  Response = c("Cyclone Freq", "Major Freq", "Prop Major", "Intense Freq", "Prop Freq"),
  `Chpt Location` = c(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]+1981,
                      ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]+1981,
                      ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1981,
                      ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]+1981,
                      ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1981),
  `p-value` =c(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[3],
               ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[3],
               ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[3],
               ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[3],
               ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[3] ),
  `Regime1` = c(mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]]),
                mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]]),
                sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]])*100,
                mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]]),
                sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[1:ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]])*100 ),
  `Regime2` = c(mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]),
                mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$major_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]),
                sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Major_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_major_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])*100,
                mean(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$intense_pois_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat]),
                sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Intense_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])/sum(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$data$Total_Storms[(ibtracs_trimmed_si_results$prop_intense_chpt_test[2]+1):num_years_hursat])*100)
  )

df |>
  mutate(Change = Regime2-Regime1,
         Perc_Change = Change/Regime1*100) |>
  knitr::kable(digits=5)
  
```
